explanation: API lemma: the number of a ∈ A with θa mod 1 in a half-open interval [t, t+1/|A|) is at most |A|, since it is the card of a filter of A. Correct and proved in the file. It supports the formulation of Green's Problem 86 (no interval of length 1/n contains more than n^c of the θa mod 1), and the docstring rightly notes the problem is trivial for c ≥ 1.
